tools.name: list_currencies
tools.description: List all coins GhostSwap supports for swapping (700+ assets). Use lite=true for just an array of tickers (e.g. ["btc","eth","ltc"]). Full metadata includes requiresExtraId + extraIdName: when the TO coin has requiresExtraId=true (XRP, XLM, ATOM, HBAR, TON…), collect the memo / destination tag before

tools.name: get_pair
tools.description: Get the min and max swap amount for a single (from, to) pair. Returns separate min/max for float-rate and fixed-rate modes.

tools.name: validate_address
tools.description: Check whether a wallet address is valid for a given currency. Returns {valid:true} or {valid:false,message}. Permissive pre-check — create_swap runs a stricter validator.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Get a live swap quote — rate, amountUserReceives, network fee, min/max. Always display amountUserReceives (not amountTo). mode="fixed" locks the rate and returns a short-lived rateId. The result includes swapUrl, a ghostswap.io link with this pair and amount filled in that the user can open to swap

tools.name: get_swap_link
tools.description: Get a ghostswap.io link that opens the swap with the coins (and optionally the amount) already filled in. Give it to the user when they want to do the swap themselves in the browser, or when create_swap isn't available. The link creates nothing and never carries an address: the user enters their own

tools.name: create_swap
tools.description: Create a new swap. Returns payinAddress where the end-user must send funds. REQUIRES refundAddress (the user's own wallet on the FROM chain). If the TO coin needs a memo / destination tag (requiresExtraId on list_currencies), pass it as extraId — without it the API returns missing_extra_id; only if

tools.name: get_swap
tools.description: Get the current status of a swap by id. Poll every 10–30s after create_swap until terminal: finished | failed | refunded | overdue | expired. `hold` = the swap is paused (poll slowly; tell the user to contact support@ghostswap.io with the swap id).

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_swap_link" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_address · Private data: validate_address, create_swap, get_swap · Public sink: create_swap.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_address · Private data: validate_address, create_swap, get_swap · Public sink: create_swap

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
